atomicity_route.conflict_note: Design concept Q14 and the reviewability budget record three ordered slices. That is not a contradiction of one-navigable-PR: the classifier distinguishes one PR from several, while the slice division fixes review order inside the work. split-PR would mean three separate pull requests; the recorded decision is one specification implemented and reviewed as three ordered slices, with roadmap Work Package A kept intact as slice 1.

layer_plan.reason: Layer planner runs only when the atomicity route is exactly split-PR. Route is one-navigable-PR, so planning is skipped and the route context is carried forward.

pr_marker_plan.reason: Whole-feature reviewable LOC is 1858, which exceeds the 800-LOC block threshold, while each slice is under it (735 / 533 / 590) and total files (23) are under the 25-file block. This is a size-only condition with a committed slice division, so it is a marker-planning input rather than a manual re-slicing stop.

ordered_markers.intact_reason: The roadmap independently requires Work Package A remain a single reviewable unit; it must not be subdivided to fit a threshold.

authoritative_figures.source: Plan-phase re-derivation from the real design; supersedes the roadmap's recorded 0 production files and the spec's 6-10 projection.

pr_marker_plan.estimator_caveat: Do not rely on estimate-reviewable-loc or a tasks-count heuristic here. The LOC estimator reports projected 0 and production 0 because its heuristic keys on path prefixes and JavaScript extensions and matches no Python in this repository. A tasks-mode heuristic of 86 tasks by 40 lines is likewise a false positive. Neither may be read as evidence that this change is small, and neither may trigger a Work Package A split.

tasks_phase_reviewability.deferral_reason: The installed runner supports reviewability-gate in setup mode only; tasks mode is deferred and must not be invoked as an active helper.
